# Detailed Content


## Pages

> Looking for expert lighting solutions in UAE? Microlights offers tailored lighting, expert guidance, and project support for every space.

- URL: https://www.microlights.com/

Microlights was founded in 2002 when a lighting manufacturer based in the West of England, producing luminaires and related components, expanded into the Middle East by establishing Microlights Dubai. Since then the company has supplied lighting products, value-added solutions, and designs directly to retail and commercial end-users across the Middle East, building 25+ years of relationships with major brands. The homepage highlights three product lines (Indoor, Outdoor, Industrial) and five served industries: Retail/Fashion, Commercial, F&B, Residential, Industrial, and Hospitality. Recent project case studies featured include Bateel, Boots, McDonald's, Khaadi, and American Eagle. Client testimonials cite long-standing relationships (some spanning 13+ years) with contacts at Bateel International, McDonald's, and AlSayer Franchising, praising professionalism, product range evolution, and responsiveness.


> Microlights is a trusted lighting contractor in UAE, delivering innovative lighting solutions, expert support, and quality execution.

- URL: https://www.microlights.com/about-us

For 25 years Microlights has operated as a lighting partner across the GCC, Europe, and Asia, providing lighting products, value-added solutions, and design services with a stated commitment to sustainability. An in-house design team works alongside technical and project management staff to deliver projects for the Retail, Hospitality, Commercial, Residential, and Industrial sectors, including Smart Lighting Solutions, on-site inspections, wireless Bluetooth dimming control, and after-sales support.

Mission: "Lighting the Way Forward" — to stay unique and innovative while ensuring customer satisfaction and being a hub of lighting and technical knowledge.
Vision: to be the go-to destination for lighting needs, providing sustainable solutions and instilling customer confidence.
Values: Teamwork, Passion, Innovation, Integrity, Listening to customers.

"Why Microlights" pillars: Client-First Approach (design consultation through ongoing technical advice), Quality & Sustainability (high-grade sustainable materials, rigorous testing), Sales Team Consultation (needs-based tailored solutions), Tailor-Made Design (bespoke, transparent, collaborative), Factory & Warehouse Logistics (careful packing, labelling, timely delivery), Professional On-Site Visits (technical advice to contractors), and Ongoing After-Care Support (maintenance, technical support, follow-up).


> Work with a LEED-focused lighting company in the UAE. Deliver sustainable, compliant, and efficient lighting solutions.

- URL: https://www.microlights.com/sustainability

Microlights positions sustainability as central to its operations, from product design and manufacturing through distribution and after-sales service. Sustainability practices cover four areas: Energy-Efficient Products (LED technology and smart controls that optimize energy use), Eco-Friendly Manufacturing (recyclable materials, green processes), Waste Minimization (recycling/repurposing of by-products), and Sustainable Design Practices (durability, recyclability, adaptability to extend product lifespan).

Certifications & standards referenced: LEED (many projects contribute to LEED certification), plus SASO, KUCAS, and ESMA product compliance certifications for regional markets. Stated future goals: Carbon Reduction, Waste Minimization, Green Technology Innovation, and Supply Chain Sustainability.


> Explore indoor, outdoor, and industrial lighting solutions in the UAE. High-performance products designed for efficiency and durability.

- URL: https://www.microlights.com/lighting-products

A filterable product catalogue (by category, type, and location) covering three main lighting lines: Indoor Lighting, Outdoor Lighting, and Industrial Lighting. Products are aimed at Retail, Commercial, F&B, Residential, Industrial, and Hospitality applications, and are cross-linked throughout the site as the basis for the company's project and design-services work. A downloadable product brochure is available from the site footer.


> Looking for expert Lighting Design Service in UAE? Microlights delivers innovative lighting solutions that elevate every space.

- URL: https://www.microlights.com/services/lighting-design

Covers Microlights' in-house lighting design capability: taking a project from concept through detailed design, working with architects and clients to translate space and brand requirements into a lighting scheme, and specifying fixtures from the company's own indoor, outdoor, and industrial product ranges. Positioned as a value-engineering service that pairs creative design with product supply, distinguishing Microlights from a pure product distributor.


> Expert lighting project management in the UAE. From planning to on-site execution, ensure efficient, on-time project delivery.

- URL: https://www.microlights.com/services/project-management

Describes Microlights' PM process: a dedicated project manager is assigned to each job to coordinate with the client's multi-disciplinary team (architects, operations, trades) from concept through completion, drawing on 25 years of experience. Six service pillars are listed: Comprehensive Lighting Management (indoor, outdoor, retrofit coordination), Expert Site Surveys (on-site needs assessment by lighting designers), Custom Lighting Design (value-engineered solutions), Dedicated Project Leadership (schedule/budget oversight), Proactive Problem Solving & Support (issue anticipation plus post-completion technical support), and Quality, Compliance & Sustainability (regulatory-compliant, energy-efficient delivery).


> Discover completed lighting projects across the UAE. From retail to industrial spaces, see how Microlights delivers efficient, high-performance solutions.

- URL: https://www.microlights.com/projects

A filterable (by location) portfolio of completed lighting projects spanning retail, F&B, industrial, and commercial spaces across the UAE. Individual project pages include named clients such as Boots, Bateel, McDonald's, Khaadi, and American Eagle, each with a short case-study write-up describing the brief, fixtures supplied, and outcome.


> Retail Lighting Solutions UAE | Boots Project

- URL: https://www.microlights.com/projects/boots

Case study on Microlights' work with Boots across its UAE retail locations. The brief was to enhance the interior atmosphere to reflect the brand's modern identity, focusing on a bright, welcoming, brand-aligned shopping environment that improves customer comfort and retail efficiency. Presented as an example of Microlights' tailored interior lighting design work for retail chains.


> Bateel, UAE — F&B Lighting Project

- URL: https://www.microlights.com/projects/bateel

Case study on the Bateel Dubai Hills Mall restaurant fit-out. Microlights designed a lighting scheme to support the venue's casual, contemporary dining atmosphere, supplying a full LED package — track lights, Eddi® downlight pendants, linear fixtures, and decorative pendants — tuned to a warm colour temperature across dining, service, and waiting zones. A dimming lighting control system was installed to allow zone- and time-based adjustment.


> Latest in Lighting Technology | Microlights Blog

- URL: https://www.microlights.com/blog

The company blog, covering lighting industry news, product trends, and technical insights aimed at lighting professionals, architects, and facilities buyers in the UAE/GCC market.


> Lighting Consultancy Dubai | Talk to Our Experts

- URL: https://www.microlights.com/contact-us

Lead-generation contact page ("Let's Talk — Do You Have a Project in Mind? Get In Touch!") with a form capturing Name, Phone, Email, Company, and Message, aimed at project enquiries and lighting consultations.


> Microlights is a trusted lighting contractor in UAE, delivering innovative lighting solutions, expert support, and quality execution.

- URL: https://www.microlights.com/our-team

Introduces Microlights' in-house team — combining design, technical, and project management staff — who work across the full project lifecycle from initial consultation and site survey through design, supply, and after-sales support.
